fieldValues.title: A level escalates, never decides for the level above
fieldValues.decision_question: What does a level do with a request outside its mandate?
fieldValues.context: D3 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A level never decides a request for the level above it; it escalates one proposed decision instead.
fieldValues.rationale: Keeps each level within its mandate: decisions go up as proposals and are never taken in place (proposal section 3).
fieldValues.revisit_when: An escalation is overturned as within the lower level's mandate.
